title: Hearty Kenyan Flaxseed Bake
description: A traditional Kenyan dish made with flaxseed, yeast, and a touch of beurre-monte, perfect for a festive gathering.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Mix the flaxseed and coconut milk in a bowl until well combined.
Add the flour, yeast, sugar, and salt to the bowl and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Gradually add the coconut oil and vanilla extract, stirring until the dough is smooth.
Transfer the dough to the prepared baking dish and smooth out the top.
Cover the dish with a clean towel and let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Bake the dough for 25 minutes or until it's golden brown.
While the dough is baking, prepare the beurre-monte by whipping heavy cream until it forms stiff peaks.
Add the sugar and vanilla extract to the whipped cream and mix until combined.
Remove the baked dough from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Spread the beurre-monte over the top of the dough and return it to the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it cool completely before slicing and serving.
